scope: Source-only review of readiness freeze-v3 in the isolated worktree. No GUI, E2E, syntax/unit/static test, build, process sampling, signature invocation, product/fixture source edit, staging or commit performed by reviewer. Only this report is written.

findings.title: Distinguish Node policy filtering from the ACC raw registry
findings.issue: The original master-off cases expected diagnostics.hidden_tools to contain policy-disabled names. The Node bridge passes external entry env unchanged; this fixture supplies ACC_HIDE_TOOLS empty in these cases. Product policy filters its offer/dispatch surface. Product-generated CLI configuration receives desktopMcpPolicyEnv separately. The initial assertion would fail before reaching later gate coverage.
findings.resolution: Master-off checks compact catalog exclusions and an unchanged raw ACC hidden_tools array; ordinary provider tool-disabled remains required. Separately reads the actual product-generated CLI configuration and checks its ACC_HIDE_TOOLS names, without manually injecting a mask or claiming an actual CLI runtime/registry execution.
sourceBasis: 07-autonomy.js policy tables, offer filtering and toolDisabledResult

findings.title: Stop immediately when a baseline action prerequisite fails
findings.issue: invoke validates the HTTP/result envelope, not result.ok. Original focus/start/sequence/stop calls ran consecutively before one combined assertion, so a refused focus or recording start would still be followed by the input call.
findings.resolution: Immediately check focus ok, controlled recording start ok/source, sequence ok, then complete collection and an actual saved path. Every check throws on failure into finally. Saved JSON/recording semantics and positive ordinary-session replay remain additional prerequisites for later negative cases.

errorCodeAssessment.sourceConclusion: One unpressed move is a valid bounded input sequence with zero flags/pressure and an explicit keyboard-layout source. Controlled record.start returns source=controlled_native_requests; record.stop produces schema1, complete actions and optional saved path. Saved JSON is read back and replayed with the same owned target. Positive batch completed1/failed0 is source-consistent.
errorCodeAssessment.limits: Native dispatch success is checked; the suite is not an independent proof of physical event consumption or a new approval allow/deny/cancel suite.

errorCodeAssessment.sourceConclusion: Node MacDesktopAutomation and Python macos.request map the nonexistent helper to dependency_missing. ACC list_tools filters native capability families by current readiness; macro_run stays registered, then prepare_recording performs record.target via missing helper and the server converts DesktopError to a coded false envelope. Input/recording/AX diagnostics default false when capability cannot load.

Actual ACC_HIDE_TOOLS=input_sequence removes that tool from FastMCP live registry. macro_run prepare_recording verifies the target, then _tool_map detects the absent expanded input_sequence and returns tool_unavailable before _run_batch dispatch.

errorCodeAssessment.expected: completed0/failed1 and unknown or non-batchable error
errorCodeAssessment.sourceConclusion: _run_batch reads the same live registry, rejects the missing nested tool with the asserted error text and never invokes it.

Both policies disable macro_run/batch_actions; desktop policy also hides sequence/focus and command policy hides launch/run/kill. Raw ACC registry stays unchanged in this Node path. Catalog omits names, route retained for policy refusal before lookup. Generated CLI config obtains exact policy mask from product function; command-off leaves list_windows independent desktop read offered.

isolationAndPreflightAssessment.homes: self-isolate-home is first require. Each scenario gets private HOME/USERPROFILE/AppData/WCW_DATA_DIR plus private RUYI_HOME and data; inherited environment is overridden in the correct order. WCW_SESSION_ID is blank. ACC is a real Python stdio service with explicit source PYTHONPATH and toolsets.
isolationAndPreflightAssessment.backgroundWork: Desktop autodetect, MCP drop-ins, Claude config import, workbench MCP, scheduler and steward are disabled; model provider alone is fake/offline.
isolationAndPreflightAssessment.ownedTarget: list_windows target must match the receiver child PID and ready window handle. The baseline focus is required before controlled recording and bounded unpressed movement.
isolationAndPreflightAssessment.serialFailureStop: A single service is active at a time; startService first awaits complete prior cleanup and refuses further cases if cleanupSafe is false. Assertions throw, ending scenario progression and entering finally.
isolationAndPreflightAssessment.approvalAndStream: Inherited NDJSON buffering handles chunk boundaries and retains asynchronous decision errors until settlement. Exec calls use an actual created session, default config, provider tool_call and intervention decisions; the separate existing entry suite remains the explicit allow/deny/cancel acceptance.
isolationAndPreflightAssessment.auditAndReceiver: Negative cases compare receiver counts and require no input_sequence/focus/mouse_move audit in the isolated ACC tail; hidden batch checks no sequence audit. The move itself is not counted by receiver.counts, so absence-of-input evidence also depends on live registry/error and audit checks, rather than treating count equality alone as a pointer movement observation.

cleanupAssessment.sourceConclusion: Uses prior reviewed birth-aware killOwnTree and owned snapshots. Before service cleanup, matching service identity is required and only matching native input-session workers receive cooperative SIGTERM. Cleanup receipts must not be incomplete/skipped, root exit and all observed identities must be confirmed. Receiver gets quit and observed identities are checked. Input source restoration is required if selected. Incomplete cleanup marks failure and preserves the root.
cleanupAssessment.scope: Observed identities only; no census of unobserved escaped/reparented children is established. No new failure injection or cleanup execution occurred in this review.
cleanupAssessment.clipboard: This slice does not seed/paste clipboard data; receiver clipboard fixture is not enabled. No new clipboard restoration result is claimed.
